items.headline: CPU TTS benchmark with UTMOS MOS scoring: Kokoro, Supertonic, Inflect-Nano, and Kyutai's new Pocket TTS [P]
items.summary: Sharing a CPU TTS benchmark with objective MOS scores in case it's useful for anyone evaluating small TTS models. Adding this because Kyutai's Pocket TTS is architecturally different from the others in the field and I hadn't seen a head-to-head with it yet.
